response.justification: The candidate significantly exceeds the 6+ years requirement with nearly two decades of fullstack experience, strong TypeScript/Node.js depth, recent hands-on AI agent and MCP tooling work, and a demonstrable testing and software craftsmanship culture (TDD, CI/CD, workshops). Cloud (AWS CDK), Kubernetes, Docker, MongoDB, and React are all covered. Gaps exist around the specific frameworks in the primary stack (Nest.js, Vitest) and Kotlin, but these appear readily learnable given the breadth shown.
strengths: Deep fullstack TypeScript/Node.js experience across multiple senior roles
Recent AI agent development experience, including MCP code generators and agentic tooling
Strong testing/quality culture: TDD, trunk-based development, testing workshops, and open-source test tooling
concerns: No explicit Nest.js or Vitest/Jest/Playwright experience listed
No Kotlin experience; Java exposure appears dated and limited
Frontend history leans heavily on Ember.js; React experience is comparatively recent

key_factors.factor: Missing primary-stack frameworks (Nest.js, Vitest) and Kotlin
